gate_jump_table.rule: tag byte minus 3 indexes the table (unsigned); an index above 10 goes straight to the counter path

inferences: the tag-13 query is the fifth caller of the throttle gate and the largest of the query family: same gate, handler-chain walk, framing and delivery as the tag-3/tag-4 queries and the tag-5/tag-6 twins, but a count-mismatch prologue, a record loop and a nine-comparison walk (three links shallower than the tag-3/tag-4 queries)

the gate is a throttle: the message is built only while the target's slot +0x20 return does not exceed the limit at obj+0x08, while the tag's flag bit in obj+0x18 is clear, and once every limit-at-obj+0x10 qualifying calls

the first tag-13 caller follows the tag-4 caller pattern (0x606ca40 first, obj from +0x650, null-checked); the other two callers first zip a qword array and a 16-byte-record array into the two ranges, then free both ranges after the call
the tag-13 message's first 8 bytes are a presence mask with only bits 8, 9 and 10 set (0x700), followed by LE32(count) and the two length-prefixed strings S2 and S3
the second landing pad (message only) covers the handler-walk region, where S2 and S3 are not yet built; the first landing pad (all three strings) covers the loop and append region

fields: mask: 8 raw bytes of the presence-mask qword (bits 8, 9 and 10, 0x700)
count: LE32 of the record count (equal to the element count on this path)
S2: ULEB128(len(S2)) || S2, where S2 concatenates one LE32 per element, each the u32 returned by virtual slot +0x18 on that element; the S2 length is encoded from its low 32 bits

S3: ULEB128(len(S3)) || S3, where S3 concatenates one ULEB128(len) || data per 16-byte record; each length is encoded from its low 32 bits while the full length is appended; each pair is appended unconditionally, even for a zero length
the loop runs once per record (index stepping 8 over count*8 bytes): element = *(elements.begin + index), record = records.begin + index*2
tag13.guards: every append checks remaining capacity against 0x3fffffffffffffff and throws __throw_length_error with "basic_string::append" (string at 0x4474d2) on overflow; nine length-error arms in the tag-13 query
tag13.layout: mask8 || LE32(count) || ULEB128(len(S2)) || S2 || ULEB128(len(S3)) || S3
